problem: The production browser gate used a 390px mobile viewport but tried to click the hidden desktop language button. The real mobile UX exposes a language select inside the opened mobile menu.
root_cause: The verifier asserted the desktop control implementation instead of following the surface-specific visible user path.
prevention: Mobile browser gates must operate controls that are visible and actionable in the mobile UI.
For public language switching on mobile: open #bgkopKnop, use [data-bg-language-select], prove /en/*, then roundtrip to the unprefixed Dutch route.
Do not weaken locale assertions: html lang, visible English content, absence of runtime translation error, and Dutch canonical roundtrip remain mandatory.
